name: Eat The Universe Simulator
desc:
☀️ In this simulator you eat the worlds, stars, asteroids, and even galaxies! Start as a Dust particle, and grow to become a Galaxy! Become the largest object in the universe in this simulator!

 Use Codes: "BlackHolesRevenge", "SPONSOR", "1M", "10kLikes"

⚫️Black Holes now in game! They eat your Mass

💫Pets orbit you

🔭Look for unique space objects

🌌 Eat asteroids/planets/stars and become the biggest!
⭐️Rebirth to upgrade your stats and abilities
☄️Launch Asteroids into your friends & enemies. 
🔰Use Shield to save your Mass from damage
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and become #1!

🎮 Console Friendly!
📱 Mobile/Tablet Friendly!
